niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, target markets, creative needs, and whether you want managed/full-service support or programmatic/self‑serve execution. Here’s a short guide to help you pick and some leading providers by use case.

What to consider first
- Campaign objective: brand awareness, direct response, lead gen, or attribution-driven performance.  
- Scale and geography: national vs local; US vs global.  
- Buying method: managed/direct buys on publishers vs programmatic DSPs.  
- Creative needs: static repurposed video vs dynamic/personalized CTV creative.  
- Measurement & attribution requirements: third‑party verification, cross‑screen measurement.  
- Budget: transactional self‑serve tools favor smaller budgets; big media groups suit large media spends.

Who to consider (by type and strengths)
- Large media agencies (full service): WPP, Omnicom, Publicis, IPG, Dentsu (and their agency networks). Strength: end‑to‑end strategy, buying scale, premium publisher relationships, advanced measurement and planning. Good if you want an agency to handle everything and have larger budgets.
- Programmatic DSPs / self‑serve platforms: The Trade Desk (strong CTV targeting and measurement), Amazon Ads (Fire TV reach + first‑party data), Roku Ads / OneView (direct access to Roku audience). Strength: more control, real‑time bidding, usually better for performance/optimization.
- Creative & measurement specialists: Innovid (interactive/dynamic CTV creative), VideoAmp (holistic analytics and optimization), DoubleVerify / IAS / Nielsen (viewability and independent measurement). Use these alongside a buyer or agency.
- Supply/SSP and ad-management: FreeWheel (premium TV publisher connections, Comcast), Magnite/SpotX (streaming supply partners). Useful if you need premium inventory or publisher partnerships.
- Boutique CTV agencies / performance shops: Many independent specialists focus purely on CTV and OTT (good for nimble strategy and often better CPM transparency). Which is best depends on niche and region — I can shortlist options if you give details.

Quick recommendations based on need
- If you want full-service national/global brand campaigns: use a major media agency within WPP/Omnicom/Publicis/IPG/Dentsu.  
- If you want programmatic performance and self-serve control: look at The Trade Desk, Roku Ads, Amazon Ads.  
- If you need advanced creative personalization or interactive ads: consider Innovid or boutique CTV creative shops.  
- If you need independent measurement and cross‑screen attribution: pair your buy with VideoAmp, Nielsen, DoubleVerify, or IAS.

If you tell me your budget, target market (country/DMAs), primary objective (brand vs performance), and whether you prefer managed agency help or self‑serve platforms, I’ll shortlist 3–5 specific agencies/platforms that are the best fit.
